77700001:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset: one original trading-card illustration, square 1024x1024 PNG, full-bleed art only.
Series: Chain Code, luminous cybernetic lifeforms empowered by stacked chains of effects. Consistent visual language: platinum-white armor, cyan emissive seams, restrained gold accents, linked oval rings made of solid light, a chain-ring emblem on each creature's chest or head. Bright clean light-element energy. Deep digital space, circuit traces, holographic grids, geometric light rails and flowing data. Small abstract brace, arrow and double-colon motifs may appear as nonverbal glyphs.
Style: highly detailed polished fantasy science-fiction digital painting, dramatic lighting, readable silhouette, strong central subject, painterly depth and material detail, elaborate original designs.
Constraints: no card border, no UI, no title, no labels, no statistics, no watermark, no signature, no logos, no readable text. Only tiny 1, 2, 3 engravings on chain rings are permitted. Do not imitate any existing trading-card character or specific existing card artwork. Fully opaque background.
